# Parameters

<!-- Generated by `pnpm harness parameters --markdown --out documentation/parameters.md` from `packages/orchestrator/src/parameters.ts`: edit the catalogue, not this page. A test fails when they differ. -->

The audit of every setting: the 40 keys of `RunConfig` (`packages/orchestrator/src/run.ts`), the 133 flags of `harness`, and the keys of the host profiles. The catalogue is typed over `RunConfig`, so a key added there without an entry does not compile; a test holds the flags to the parser's table and the host keys to the shipped profiles. It is the source a settings menu of the graphical interface ([ui.md](ui.md)) reads. Nothing in it changes what a run does.

Columns: **default** is what `harness run` has when nothing sets it; **sets** is what the defaults sets `v1` and `v2` of `harness solve` do ([quickstart.md](quickstart.md#defaults-sets)); **status** is `stable`, `beta`, `experimental` or `internal` (set by the harness); **ui** is whether a settings menu shows it (`basic`, `advanced`, `hidden`).

### scheduling

How the budget is spent over problems and launches: the gate, the rounds, the share, the typed decisions.

| key | type | default | what it changes | flags | sets | docs | test | status | ui |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `concurrency` | integer >= 1 | 1 | Problems worked on at the same time (1 when the problems are a sequence). | `--concurrency` | - | m0-loop.md#A run | `rounds.test.ts` | stable | advanced |
| `budgetRounds` | boolean | absent (off) | With a run budget and several problems, the problems are worked round-robin under a cap that doubles each round, and a problem without Lean progress is parked. | none | v2: true (does nothing in solve, which has one problem) | scheduler.md#The budget in rounds | `rounds.test.ts` | stable | advanced |
| `budgetShare` | number > 0 | absent (off) | With a run budget, a problem's ledger is capped when it is opened at min(problemUsd, budgetShare x what remains of the run budget / problems not finished). | none | v2: 2 | scheduler.md#The budget in rounds | `budget-share.test.ts` | stable | advanced |
| `decide` | { backend?: llm \| jev, sites?: Record<site, llm \| jev \| off>, votes?: integer 1..9 } | absent (the run's model decides everywhere) | Who makes the typed decisions that order work: the run's model, or a third-party backend (Jev), per site, with one to nine votes. | `--decide-backend` `--decide-site` `--decide-votes` | - | decide.md#Backends and configuration | `decide.test.ts` | experimental | advanced |
| `gate` | { share?, floor?, probeFraction?, margin?, minSessions?, probeExtend? } | absent (no gate: the provers start together) | The budget gate: a deterministic rule before every paid launch, a probe-first start that widens only after Lean progress, and a run on `--memory-from` that relaunches nothing already certified. | `--gate` `--gate-floor` `--gate-probe` `--gate-margin` `--gate-min-sessions` `--gate-share` | v1: {}; v2: { probeExtend: true } (solve always has the gate on) | scheduler.md#The budget gate | `budget-gate.test.ts` | stable | advanced |

`decide`:

- backend (llm | jev, llm): --decide-backend
- sites (Record<site, llm | jev | off>, {}): --decide-site SITE=BACKEND
- votes (integer 1..9, 1): --decide-votes

`gate`:

- share (Partial<Record<wave|session|task|judge, number in (0,1]>>, wave 0.5, session 0.5, task 0.25, judge 0.1): --gate-share SITE=X
- floor (number, 0.1): fraction of skips let through; --gate-floor
- probeFraction (number, 0.1): the probe's share of the problem budget; --gate-probe
- margin (number, 0.1): the tie margin where decide is asked; --gate-margin
- minSessions (integer >= 1, 2): sessions a prover runs before the gate can end it; --gate-min-sessions
- probeExtend (boolean, false): one extension for a probe its cap cut; no flag

`intake`:

## Settings file

`harness run` and `harness solve` take `--settings FILE`: a JSON object whose keys are `RunConfig` keys (documentation/quickstart.md, "A settings file"). The order is the defaults set, then the file, then the flags, which win. A key the harness sets itself (`status` internal) or a hidden one (`ui` hidden) is refused naming the key, and so is a value that fails the type below or `checkConfig`. In `solve`, the keys its own flags take are refused naming the flag: `model` (`--model`), `budget` (`--max-usd`), `consortium` (`--turn-usd`), `gate` (`--defaults`), `intake` (`--intake`), `tools` (`--tool`), `autoTool` (`--auto-tool`), `private` (`--private`).

The file accepts these 35 keys, the ones a settings menu of the interface shows: `model`, `thinkingLevel`, `provers`, `sessions`, `limits`, `notesChars`, `budget`, `concurrency`, `tools`, `autoTool`, `firstCases`, `informalFirst`, `triage`, `cards`, `sorryBattery`, `cacheRetention`, `checkTimeoutSec`, `editTool`, `maskOldChecks`, `leanSearch`, `stateCard`, `consolidation`, `budgetRounds`, `budgetShare`, `consult`, `roles`, `lines`, `lineOptions`, `consortium`, `offpeak`, `seed`, `decide`, `gate`, `intake`, `private`.

Refused: `selection`, `optionalTools`, `packetMode`, `defaults`, `prompts`.

## Command line flags

One table for every flag of `harness` (the keys of `CLI_OPTIONS` in `cli-options.ts`). One parser serves every command, so the *commands* column says where a flag is read.

| flag | commands | sets | help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--host` | capabilities, health, lit probe, contract, run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe, resume, solve, doctor, consolidate | host: config/hosts/HOST.json | The host profile; default HARNESS_HOST, then local (solve and doctor use the sandboxed profile doctor wrote, when it exists). |
| `--implementation` | contract | the implementation to test | Test one implementation of the capability. |
| `--case` | contract | the contract cases to run | Run only the named case (repeatable). |
| `--out` | contract, lit probe, run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe, solve, consolidate, heuristics, library, view | an output file or directory | Where the command writes: a directory for a run, ablation or proposals, a file for a contract report, a view or the mined cards. |
| `--reference` | audit | a directory of reference dossiers | Show DIR/PROBLEM.md beside each dossier. |
| `--query` | lit probe | the query words | The words searched. |
| `--limit` | lit probe | hits per site | How many hits to ask for. |
| `--no-cache` | lit probe | skip the response cache | Do not read or write the cache. |
| `--include-computed` | library | export option | library export: include `computed` lemmas. |
| `--config` | library | the library builder's config file | library build: the builder's configuration (default config/library-builder.json). |
| `--adopt` | library | a checkout to land an accepted build in | library build: land the accepted build's files in this checkout. |
| `--approve` | library | the person who approves an adoption | library build --adopt: the approving person's name. |
| `--registry` | library | the registry directory of definitions | library definitions, review, deprecate, build: the registry (default library/registry). |
| `--library-registry` | run | RunOptions.libraryRegistry | Start the run with the definitions of this registry (default library/registry when it exists). |
| `--runs` | library, ui | the directory of runs | library build --adopt: refuse while a run under this directory is being written; ui: where runs are listed and written (default runs). |
| `--reason` | library | the reason of a deprecation | library deprecate: why the definition is dropped. |
| `--bench` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe, resume | the bench index file | The bench index (default bench/fc-bench-v1-discrete.json), or a graded bench with --grade. |
| `--grade` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | the grade of a graded bench | A, B or C: which grade of --bench FILE. |
| `--allow-unchecked` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | admit entries no Lean admitted | With a graded bench: allow entries that no Lean admitted. |
| `--checkout` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe, resume | the bench repository's checkout | A checkout of the bench's repository. |
| `--sample` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts | RunConfig.selection | Choose N problems at random. |
| `--seed` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts | RunConfig.selection | The seed of --sample (default m0); not the seed of the memory draws (that is --draw-seed). |
| `--problem` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts | RunConfig.selection | Choose a problem by id (repeatable). |
| `--all` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts | RunConfig.selection | Every problem of the bench. |
| `--sequence` | run, ablate | RunConfig.selection | A sequence of the bench, worked in order with --concurrency 1. |
| `--tag` | run, ablate | RunConfig.selection | The problems tagged analogy or induction. |
| `--model` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe, solve, doctor, consolidate | RunConfig.model | PROVIDER/ID; default SESHAT_MODEL (not for a resume); without either, solve and doctor take the cheapest priced model. |
| `--thinking` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | RunConfig.thinkingLevel | off, minimal, low, medium (default), high, xhigh or max. |
| `--provers` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | RunConfig.provers | Provers per problem (default 4). |
| `--sessions` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | RunConfig.sessions | Sessions per prover (default 8). |
| `--turns` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | RunConfig.limits.turns | Model responses per session (default 40); not the turn of --turn-usd. |
| `--context-tokens` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | RunConfig.limits.contextTokens | Prompt size that ends a session (default 120000). |
| `--notes-chars` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | RunConfig.notesChars | The length limit of the notes (default 4000). |
| `--cache-retention` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | RunConfig.cacheRetention | none, short or long: the prompt cache retention asked of the provider. |
| `--packet-mode` | run, ablate, optimize-prompts, probe | RunConfig.packetMode | prefix_tail (default), append_only or recompiled. |

## Host profile keys

The keys of `config/hosts/*.json` (`packages/registry/src/host.ts`). `*` stands for a model or a capability id.

| key | type | what it does | in a shipped profile |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | string (^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$) | The profile's name; required. | yes |
| `description` | string | Free text for a person; nothing reads it. | yes |
| `leanEnv` | string | The Lean environment of the host (lean/env/NAME.toml), usually ${env:LEAN_ENV:-base}; absent: the host names none and tool runs record the manifests' pins alone. | yes |
| `models` | Record<provider/id, ModelEntry> | What the host says of the models a run uses; a model with no entry is charged at pi-ai's numbers and ignores no setting. | yes |
| `models.*.pricing` | object | Dollars per million tokens: cacheHit, cacheMiss, output, and an optional calendar. | yes |
| `models.*.ignores` | Record<setting, string[]> | The sampling settings a model's family ignores (not sent, recorded as ignored). | yes |
| `checkTimeoutSec` | number >= 1 | The seconds a prover's Lean check may take under `RunConfig.checkTimeoutSec`; absent: DEFAULT_CHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC (120). | no |
| `healthTimeoutMs` | integer >= 1 | How long `harness health` waits for an implementation; absent: DEFAULT_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_MS (15000). | no |
| `leanServerMemoryWarnMb` | number >= 1 | `harness doctor` warns when the Lean server's resident memory passes it; absent: 8192. | no |
| `capabilities` | Record<capability id, CapabilityBinding> | The capabilities the host offers; one the profile does not name is unavailable. | yes |
| `capabilities.*.use` | string[] (min 1) | Implementation ids in order of preference; the next is tried only when one cannot be reached. | yes |
| `capabilities.*.settings` | Record<implementation id, object> | Settings of an in-process implementation, or fields of an MCP server that replace the manifest's; ${env:NAME} reads a variable. | yes |
| `capabilities.*.timeoutMs` | integer >= 1 | Replaces the manifest's time limit on this host. | yes |
| `capabilities.*.optional` | boolean | The harness can do without it: `harness health` shows an unreachable implementation as a warning (default false). | yes |

## Defaults sets and arms

`harness solve --defaults v1|v2` (`DEFAULTS_SETS`, `SOLVE_SWITCHES` and `setConfig` in `student.ts`):

- `v1`: no `RunConfig` field beyond `defaults`, `gate: {}`, the lines M1 and M10, the consortium turn limit and the budget.
- `v2`: `v1` plus `editTool`, `maskOldChecks`, `checkTimeoutSec` (the host's, 120 by default), `stateCard`, `budgetRounds`, `budgetShare: 2`, `firstCases`, `gate.probeExtend`, line M6 with its repeat rule alone, and the solve-level switches: the intake, `autoTool`, `leanSearch` and `lean.lsp` in `tools` (the last three when the host offers them).
- Arms of `harness ablate --experiment solve-defaults`: `solve-v1`, `solve-v2`, `solve-v2-blueprints`, `solve-v2-graph`, `solve-v2-blueprints-refine`, `solve-v2-informal` (adds `informalFirst`), `solve-v2-cards` (adds `cards`), `solve-v2-cpu` (adds `sorryBattery`).

## Findings

What the audit found, one line each. Nothing is fixed by this page.

From the tables (computed):

- `firstCases` (stable) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `informalFirst` (experimental) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `triage` (experimental) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `cards` (experimental) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `sorryBattery` (experimental) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `checkTimeoutSec` (stable) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `editTool` (stable) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `maskOldChecks` (stable) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `stateCard` (stable) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `budgetRounds` (stable) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).
- `budgetShare` (stable) has no CLI flag: settings file only (`--settings`).

From reading the code:

- No flag of `harness run` or `harness solve` sets `editTool`, `maskOldChecks`, `checkTimeoutSec`, `stateCard`, `budgetRounds`, `budgetShare`, `firstCases`, `triage`, `informalFirst` or `cards`: `--settings FILE` sets them (the section "Settings file"), and the defaults set `v2` turns the first seven on.
- `informalFirst` and `cards` are also set by the arms `solve-v2-informal` and `solve-v2-cards` of `harness ablate --experiment solve-defaults`; `ablate` does not read `--settings`, and no defaults set has them.
- One parser serves every command (`CLI_OPTIONS`): a flag a command does not read is accepted and ignored there (`harness report --provers 4` runs). Only `resume` refuses the flags that describe a run.
- Two flags mean different things by command: `--target` (ablate: a ratio; optimize-prompts: a prompt name) and `--split` (ablate: a number of problems; optimize-prompts: a split name).
- Two names for the seed: `--seed` seeds `--sample` (recorded in `selection`), `--draw-seed` seeds the memory draws (`RunConfig.seed`); the key and the flag do not match.
- Three names for a dollar limit: `--budget-usd` and `--run-budget-usd` (run), `--max-usd` (solve, which sets both fields of `budget`), `--turn-usd` (`consortium.limit.usd`); `--max-usd` also means a cap in `consolidate` and `optimize-prompts`.
- `--turns` (`limits.turns`, model responses per session) and `--turn-tokens`, `--turn-usd`, `--turn-minutes` (the consortium turn) are easily confused; `--consolidation` (`consolidation`), `--turn-consolidation` (`consortium.consolidation`) and the command `harness consolidate` are three different things.
- `consult.model` and `roles.consult.model` are two ways to name the consult model (documented: `consult.model` wins); `--consult` and `--role consult=` set them.
- `--private` is listed in the usage of `ablate` as meaning something only with `--experiment solve-defaults`, but the code sets `private` for every ablate run that is given the flag.
- `--lit` and `--sketch` are accepted by `run` and refused there with a message; `--no-intake`, `--no-auto-tool`, `--no-lean-search` matter only with `--defaults v2` and are ignored under `v1`.
- `--no-tool` can drop only `lean.lsp`; any other id is a usage error.
- `prompts`, `optionalTools`, `selection` and `defaults` are set by the harness, not a person (`--defaults` is a flag, but it names a set rather than a value).
- The impasse text in documentation/human.md says "at or below" `--impasse-posterior`, as the code does (`mean <= posteriorBelow`), while the field is named `posteriorBelow`: the name says "below".
- The shipped host profiles (`local.json`, `server.json`) set none of `checkTimeoutSec`, `healthTimeoutMs`, `leanServerMemoryWarnMb`, so every host uses the code's defaults for them (120 s, 15000 ms, 8192 MB).
